🔄 Content Updated (Published: October 26, 2026 / Previously listed: May 30, 2026)
Main change: The gift for coupon use has been changed from a Moomin Valley Park original sticker to an original clip.

We are selling the "Hanno Enjoy! Moomin Valley Park Outing Pass (Digital)" for the second half of fiscal year 2026 (Reiwa 8). This package ticket includes a Seibu Railway one-day pass, a Moomin Valley Park one-day pass, and a round-trip bus ticket, plus 1,000 yen in "Hanno Enjoy! Coupons" usable at 45 participating shops throughout Hanno City. Anyone who uses the coupon receives a Moomin Valley Park original clip as a gift. Enjoy exploring Hanno City and visiting Moomin Valley Park at a great value.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/kikakuka/tihousouseikouikigyousei/sangakukanrenkei/13563.html
